description: Find what Spoofy can do for a link or a goal, with prices. ALWAYS call this first: service ids come from here. Give `link` (any profile, post, video, channel, group, token page or website URL) and/or `goal` in plain words, e.g. "500 followers on my tiktok" or "cheap views for this YouTube video". With a link you only get services that fit that exact link (a profile link gets followers, a post link gets likes/views). Returns matching services: `service` (the id to quote/order), name, tier (basic/standard/premium), pricePer1k (USD per 1,000 units), min/max quantity, start time, speed, preset packages with USD prices, and — when the goal names a quantity — a `suggestion` with the exact total for that quantity. A service with an `input` needs those fields in place_order `inputs` (custom comments, accounts to mention, a hashtag, a poll option, runs, subscription terms); `input.quantity` says where the quantity comes from. `query` narrows to services whose words match, e.g. "usa", "brazil", "real", "story". Free; spends nothing. On every service, counts can drop after delivery and drops are not replaced — tell the user before they buy followers, members or likes.

goal.description: What the user wants in words, e.g. "1k followers", "2.5k views, cheapest", "telegram members".

link.description: The URL to grow, e.g. https://x.com/yourname or https://www.tiktok.com/@you/video/123.

query.description: Optional words every service returned must match: a country or region ("usa", "europe"), a quality ("real", "premium"), a kind ("story", "reels").

name: find_services
title: Find services
